title: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Content-Rich Text-to-Image Generation
layout_note: A text encoder-decoder runs left to right (small orange Transformer Encoder at lower left, large blue Transformer Decoder raised in the middle) and a green ViT-VQGAN container sits at the right with a photo above (output) and the same photo below (input); dashed lines labelled Train and Inference connect the decoder's token ends to the tokenizer and detokenizer.
grouping: Colour per component: orange for the text encoder and its text-token bars, blue for the decoder and its image-token bars, and a light-green rounded container titled ViT-VQGAN holding two grey Image Tokenizer / Image Detokenizer boxes stacked vertically.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin coloured outlines and pastel fills; tokens are small tall rounded bars (orange for t_1..t_N, blue for <sos>, i_1..i_M) with short black arrows up into the model; sublabels (Transformer) in italics; two real photos of dogs.
proposed_highlight: The decoder that generates image tokens is the largest box, drawn in blue at the centre and raised above the encoder; the tokenizer is set apart as a separate green container on the right, and the Train / Inference dashed paths show where it plugs in.
lesson: Show a two-part generator by colour-matching each tokenised input row to its model (orange text bars under the encoder, blue image bars under the decoder) and connect the image tokenizer by dashed lines labelled Train and Inference rather than by solid flow.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2206.10789); venue remembered as TMLR 2022 (not printed on the arXiv first page). The figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded one embedded image covering it), so the palette includes the dog photos. paradigm_source is true for Parti itself; its image tokenizer builds on ViT-VQGAN / VQGAN.

arrangement.units: One composition: orange encoder box (lower left), blue decoder box (centre, raised) and a green rounded ViT-VQGAN container (right) holding the tokenizer and detokenizer; no outer frames.
arrangement.inputs_as: the plain-text sentence 'Two dogs running in a field' under orange token bars at the bottom left, and a real photo at the bottom right feeding the tokenizer
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; the Train dashed path from the tokenizer to the decoder's last input token stands in for teacher forcing
arrangement.shared: the same dog photo appears as input below and output above the ViT-VQGAN container

taxonomy.task: autoregressive text-to-image generation over image tokens

core.what: text tokens enter a small Transformer encoder at lower left, which feeds a large Transformer decoder in the centre that emits image tokens i_1, i_2, ... <eos>, turned into an image by a ViT-VQGAN container at the right

relations.form: left to right: orange text token bars t_1..t_N under the encoder box, an arrow into the side of the blue decoder box, output token labels above the decoder, then a dashed 'Inference' line to the detokenizer and the generated photo above it
the decoder's inputs <sos>, i_1, i_2, ..., i_M are drawn as blue bars below it, shifted by one from its outputs i_1, i_2, i_3, <eos> above, showing autoregressive decoding
a green rounded ViT-VQGAN container at the right stacks Image Tokenizer under Image Detokenizer, with a real photo below as tokenizer input and the same photo above as detokenizer output
two dashed paths leave the side of the ViT-VQGAN container: 'Train' from the tokenizer to the decoder's input tokens, 'Inference' from the decoder's output tokens to the detokenizer

channels.colour: orange = text side (encoder and text tokens), blue = image-token decoder and its tokens, green = ViT-VQGAN, light grey = its two sub-modules
channels.shape: thin vertical bars = tokens, rounded boxes = modules, photos = image data
channels.line: solid = model data flow, dashed = phase-specific connection (Train vs Inference) to the tokenizer
channels.frame: green rounded container = the separately trained ViT-VQGAN

quality.strengths: Colour separates text side, image-token decoder and the image tokenizer, and the decoder is the largest element; tokens are drawn as bars on both the decoder's input and output so the shift-by-one is visible; the image appears as a real photo at both ends of the tokenizer.
quality.weaknesses: The Train dashed line runs from the tokenizer back to only the last input token i_M and the Inference line from only <eos>, so which tokens pass between decoder and VQGAN is ambiguous; the encoder-to-decoder arrow enters with an elbow; the text prompt is a loose sentence under the token bars with no link to them.

insights.structure: A small encoder at lower left feeds a large decoder in the middle, and a separate green tokenizer container stands at the right with the image above and below it.
insights.data: Text and image tokens are rows of small coloured bars with math labels underneath (t_1..t_N; <sos>, i_1..i_M), the outputs i_1..<eos> are bare labels on arrows above the decoder, and the image is a real photo.
insights.emphasis: Size and position carry importance: the blue decoder is the biggest box and sits highest among the models; the tokenizer is grouped in its own green frame.
insights.flow: Bottom-up arrows into each model, one elbow arrow from encoder to decoder, and two dashed elbow lines labelled Train (tokenizer -> decoder inputs) and Inference (decoder <eos> -> detokenizer) crossing between the decoder and the tokenizer.
insights.avoid: The Train and Inference dashed lines run in opposite directions through the same gap and cross the decoder's output side, so the two modes are easy to confuse; the prompt sentence sits detached below the encoder.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
